1150 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, and before Gregorian reform, but we use proleptic Gregorian rules).  
277 days back from Jan 1, 1150:  
Step back 1 day → Dec 31, 1149.  
Step back 276 more days:  
Dec has 31 days → go back 30 days to Dec 1, 1149 (31 days back would be Nov 30).  
From Dec 1, count months backward:  
Nov 30 days, Oct 31, Sep 30, Aug 31, Jul 31, Jun 30, May 31, Apr 30, Mar 31, Feb 28 (1149 not leap), Jan 31.  

Back from Dec 1:  
Nov: 30 days (total 30)  
Oct: 31 (total 61)  
Sep: 30 (total 91)  
Aug: 31 (total 122)  
Jul: 31 (total 153)  
Jun: 30 (total 183)  
May: 31 (total 214)  
Apr: 30 (total 244)  
Mar: 31 (total 275)  
Need 276 total back from Dec 1 → 275 days back is Mar 1, 1149. One more day back → Feb 28, 1149.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1149-02-28
